logger.doc:name: Log Starting File Generation
logger.message: Preparing file naming, output creation and immutable archival.

logger.doc:name: Log Archiving Submission
logger.message: Writing immutable submission file to archive: #[vars.archiveSubmissionFilePath]

ee:transform.doc:name: Compute Total File Sizes & Delivery Mode

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var subBytes = sizeOf(vars.submissionFileContent as Binary) var sumBytes = sizeOf(vars.summaryFileContent as Binary) var totalBytes = subBytes + sumBytes var maxBytes = (p('compliance.maxAttachmentSizeBytes') default 10485760) as Number var isOversized = totalBytes > maxBytes --- { submissionSizeBytes: subBytes, summarySizeBytes: sumBytes, totalSizeBytes: totalBytes, maxAttachmentSizeBytes: maxBytes, isOversized: isOversized, notificationMode: if (isOversized) "SECURE_LINK" else "ATTACHMENT" }

logger.doc:name: Log Archival Verified
logger.message: Report generation and archival completed. Total Size: #[vars.fileSizeMetrics.totalSizeBytes] bytes. Notification Mode: #[vars.notificationMode]
